digest.component_or_area: module-size enforcement gate and architecture compliance
propositions: 12 modules are currently grandfathered over the 800 LOC soft cap via .github/module-size-allowlist.txt and .github/module-size-ceilings.txt, allowing them to persist and grow beyond the intended limit
The allowlist/ceilings escape-hatch mechanism must be eliminated entirely and replaced with an absolute 800 LOC cap that cannot be changed through normal contribution process without admin override

Each of the 12 grandfathered modules must be split along a logical call-graph seam (not mechanical) and landed as separate Gerrit changes, graduating each split file off both the allowlist and ceilings
The module-size limit enforcement must be hardened so that the 800 LOC threshold itself cannot be modified by contributors; only manual admin override is permitted
